int_execution_lending_aave_daily.description:
Daily lending metrics per (protocol, reserve) on Gnosis Chain, covering both Aave V3 and SparkLend. Includes supply/borrow APY (forward-filled from ReserveDataUpdated events), activity metrics (unique lenders/borrowers via bitmaps, deposit/borrow/withdraw/repay volumes), and net supply change for TVL tracking. Liquidation collateral seizures are subtracted from net supply.

SCOPE — Aave V3 + SparkLend only. Agave (Aave V2 fork) is intentionally
EXCLUDED from this entire unit: it is effectively wound down on Gnosis Chain
(0 deposits in the last 90 days, only housekeeping logs), and its decoded
source events are unusable anyway (event_name is blank — no ABI registered).
Any "all Gnosis lending" TVL/user figure from this unit therefore excludes
Agave by design.

int_execution_lending_aave_diffs_daily.description:
Daily per-user scaled balance deltas for Gnosis lending markets (Aave V3
and SparkLend). Computes scaled deltas from Pool events (Supply, Withdraw,
Repay with aTokens, LiquidationCall where receiveAToken=false) and aToken
BalanceTransfer events, aggregated per (date, protocol, user, reserve).

Scaled math uses exact UInt256 WadRayMath and each pool action is paired
with the ReserveDataUpdated snapshot at the same log_index position within
its (protocol, transaction). The pairing uses an ASOF join keyed on
log_index < the action's log_index — NOT a rank-based pairing. This is
required for Spark, where FlashLoan-emitted RDUs interleave with user
action RDUs and rank-based pairing would misalign (e.g. pair the user's
Supply with the FlashLoan's RDU).

LiquidationCall rows where receiveAToken=true are intentionally excluded
because the collateral movement is already captured by the
BalanceTransfer(borrower -> liquidator) event.

diff_scaled is Int256 for exact scaled-balance arithmetic (no Float64
precision loss on amounts above 2^53 wei); a --full-refresh is required
when migrating from the previous Float64 schema.
int_execution_lending_aave_diffs_daily.name: int_execution_lending_aave_diffs_daily

int_execution_lending_aave_user_balances.description:
Daily per-user aToken balances across Gnosis lending markets (Aave V3 and
SparkLend). Reads scaled deltas from int_execution_lending_aave_diffs_daily,
builds a calendar of active (protocol, user, reserve) triples, computes
running cumulative scaled balances in Int256, then converts to underlying
amounts using the end-of-day liquidityIndex. Scoped to reserves in
lending_market_mapping.

Incremental seeding (additive, not synthetic-delta): on incremental runs the
model builds a calendar of days after a watermark, left-joins new diffs, and
computes scaled = sum(diffs) OVER (calendar) + coalesce(prev_scaled, 0).
The seed day is deduped with GROUP BY any() so unmerged ReplacingMergeTree
parts cannot double the carry-forward (the failure mode behind the exact 2x
supply spikes on 2026-06-19 / 2026-06-21). Full-refresh recomputes from the
entire diffs history.

Overlapping month repair: pass reprocess_overwrite=true with start_month /
end_month to delete+insert the window, seeding from the last good day
BEFORE start_month (same contract as int_execution_tokens_balances_native_daily).

scaled_balance and balance_raw are UInt256/Int256 for exact aToken math
(mirrors Aave's on-chain WadRayMath); a --full-refresh is required when
migrating from the previous Float64 schema so the column types are recreated.
int_execution_lending_aave_user_balances.name: int_execution_lending_aave_user_balances_daily

int_execution_lending_aave_utilization_d.description:
Daily utilization rate per (protocol, reserve) across Aave V3 and SparkLend.
Computes cumulative scaled supply/borrow positions from Pool events
(Supply/Withdraw/Borrow/Repay/LiquidationCall) using exact UInt256
WadRayMath (rayDivFloor for inflows, rayDivCeil for outflows) and pairs
each pool action with the ReserveDataUpdated snapshot at the same
log_index position within its transaction. End-of-day indices are sourced
directly from raw events so the final utilization ratio is computed in
exact arithmetic end-to-end.

cumulative_scaled_supply / cumulative_scaled_borrow are Int256 for exact
WadRayMath; a --full-refresh is required when migrating from the previous
Float64 schema so the column types are recreated.

Per-day deltas are built via UNION ALL + a single GROUP BY rather than a
FULL OUTER JOIN, which had protocol-dimension correctness issues for Spark
on ClickHouse (rows where only supply or only borrow existed on a day
diluted the cumulative).
int_execution_lending_aave_utilization_d.name: int_execution_lending_aave_utilization_daily

int_execution_mmm_controls_weekly.description:
Long-form weekly MMM control variables (macro / seasonality /
operational signals the regression conditions on but does not
attribute to). One row per (`week`, `control_name`) on the same
continuous weekly spine as KPIs / media.

Source aggregators (weekly grain):
  gno_usd_price_avg          ← avg(price) over int_execution_token_prices_daily
                               filtered to symbol='GNO'
  eth_usd_price_avg          ← avg(price) where symbol IN ('WETH','ETH')
  wxdai_eur_proxy_avg        ← avg(price) where symbol IN ('WXDAI','EURE')
  chain_gas_price_gwei_avg   ← avg(gas_price_median) over int_execution_transactions_info_daily
  chain_block_count          ← sum(n_txs)
  week_of_year               ← toWeek(week) (computed)
  week_index                 ← weeks-since-spine-start (computed)
  is_holiday_week            ← LEFT JOIN to seed mmm_holiday_weeks
  hardfork_step              ← 1 from the fork-week onward via LEFT JOIN
                               to seed mmm_hardfork_steps. Computed via
                               LEFT JOIN to a `count of forks ≤ week`
                               sub-CTE rather than a correlated subquery
                               (ClickHouse plans correlated subqueries
                               inefficiently and they OOM at scale).

Incremental on `week` (monthly partition).
int_execution_mmm_controls_weekly.name: int_execution_mmm_controls_weekly

int_execution_mmm_kpis_weekly.description:
Long-form weekly KPI registry for the Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
pipeline. One row per (`week`, `kpi_name`) on a continuous weekly
spine generated by the `weekly_spine` macro over the trailing 730
days. Every (week, kpi) pair within the registry's active range
is materialised even when the underlying source has no data: weeks
are filled with 0 for `kpi_value_method = 'sum'` and NULL for
`kpi_value_method IN ('last', 'avg', 'weighted_avg')` so the
downstream wide pivot in `fct_execution_mmm_spine_weekly` never
sees a hole that would silently truncate a regression window.

Source aggregators (one CTE each, weekly grain):
  pools_tvl_usd          ← argMax(tvl_usd, date) over fct_execution_pools_daily
                           (last-value snapshot — TVL is a stock,
                           summing over time is meaningless)
  pools_volume_usd       ← sum(volume_usd_daily) over fct_execution_pools_daily
  dex_volume_usd_dedup   ← sum(volume_usd) over fct_execution_trades_by_protocol_daily.
                           First-hop-only acknowledgement: per-tx
                           dedup on int_execution_pools_dex_trades
                           OOM'd at the 10 GiB cluster cap, so the
                           known multi-hop overcount is accepted and
                           flagged via `is_dedup_safe = false` in
                           the registry (and surfaced on the row).
  ga_active_users        ← argMax(active_users, date) over fct_execution_gnosis_app_users_daily
  ga_new_users           ← sum(new_users)
  gpay_topups_count      ← sum(n_topups) over fct_execution_gnosis_app_gpay_topups_weekly
  gpay_topups_volume_usd ← sum(volume_usd)

Adding a new KPI: append to seed `mmm_kpi_registry.csv` (drives the
spine fill) AND add an aggregator CTE here AND add a `sumIf` clause
in the wide pivot at `fct_execution_mmm_spine_weekly`.

Incremental on `week` (monthly partition).
int_execution_mmm_kpis_weekly.name: int_execution_mmm_kpis_weekly

int_execution_pools_balancer_v3_daily.description:
Daily Balancer V3 pool token balances with oracle price enrichment.
Built from delta events (LiquidityAdded, LiquidityRemoved, Swap).
Token-index resolution: LiquidityAdded/Removed carry only a positional token_index
into the Vault's address-sorted token order, but the decoded PoolRegistered
tokenConfig struct-array is unreliable (inner tokens decode to 0x0, and some entries
are bogus/misplaced addresses). So the index->address map is derived from the
address-sorted list of Swap tokens (arraySort == the Vault registration order,
verified on-chain against getPoolTokenCountAndIndexOfToken) whenever that list fully
covers the pool's registered token count; the tokenConfig sentinel-inference path
remains only as a fallback for pools whose tokens are not all traded. ERC4626
wrappers (waGno*) are resolved to underlying tokens for symbol and price lookups.
Reserve = the pool's on-chain balancesRaw: cumulative signed deltas MINUS the aggregate
(protocol + pool-creator) swap fee that Balancer V3 skims out of balancesRaw at each swap
(the LP fee portion stays in the pool). Not subtracting it accumulated a "ghost" balance
(== all protocol fees ever skimmed) that dominated once a high-throughput pool drained. The
aggregate % is time-varying (AggregateSwapFeePercentageChanged), with a 50% pre-2026-04
global default for swaps predating a pool's first change event. KNOWN RESIDUAL: aggregate
YIELD fees on rate-bearing tokens (sDAI/GNO/wstETH...) have no per-accrual event and are NOT
subtracted, so rate pools still read somewhat above on-chain balancesRaw (and the 50% default
can leave sub-unit dust negatives on a few thin pools) -- the full fix is a periodic on-chain
getTokenInfo().balancesRaw reconciliation. Fee separation uses event-level swapFeeAmountsRaw.
Excludes BPT tokens (where token_address = pool_address) and sentinel addresses. Includes
oracle price (Dune ASOF join), TVL in USD, and pool-implied token price.
int_execution_pools_balancer_v3_daily.name: int_execution_pools_balancer_v3_daily

int_execution_pools_fees_daily.description:
Daily accrued pool fees and trading volume at pool x token grain for Uniswap V3,
Swapr V3, and Balancer V3 pools, computed from Swap + Flash events (gross fees;
independent of Collect/claims). V3 swap/flash deltas are sourced from staging
models (stg_pools__uniswap_v3_events, stg_pools__swapr_v3_events) which handle
int256 two's-complement decoding. Uniswap V3 uses a static fee tier per pool
from PoolCreated; fees are applied in ppm (1e6 denominator) as
fee = swap_in_delta * fee_ppm / 1e6. Volume = gross incoming token amount per
swap; flash loans contribute 0 volume. Swapr V3 (Algebra) fees are dynamic via
Fee events — the latest fee as-of each swap is applied via ASOF join on
event_order (unix_ts * 2^32 + log_index), with swaps before the first Fee event
backfilled using the pool's first observed fee. Balancer V3 takes explicit
swapFeeAmount and amountIn fields directly from Swap events and resolves ERC4626
wrappers to underlying for token metadata. V3 token positions are mapped to
addresses via stg_pools__v3_pool_registry.

int_execution_pools_swapr_v3_daily.description:
Daily Swapr V3 pool token balances with oracle price enrichment.
Built from event deltas (Mint, Burn, Swap, Collect, Flash) with dynamic fee rates
via Fee events. Per-swap effective fee is resolved via ASOF join on event_order
(toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp(block_timestamp)) * 2^32 + log_index), falling back to
the pool's first observed fee for swaps before the first Fee event. Fees are
applied in ppm (1e6 denominator) to split each swap_in delta into a reserve
portion (delta - fee) and a fee portion. Separates reserves from unclaimed fees:
reserve_amount is the physical pool token balance (equals token_amount, matches on-chain
balanceOf); swap fees are NOT subtracted (they stay in the pool until collected);
fee_amount = swap fee income - collected fees + flash loan fees.
Includes oracle price (Dune ASOF join), TVL in USD, and pool-implied token price.

int_execution_safes.description:
Gnosis Safe deployments on Gnosis Chain.

A Safe is deployed by the SafeProxyFactory as a minimal proxy that
delegatecalls into a singleton/mastercopy. The constructor immediately
delegatecalls setup(...) on the singleton — that's how we identify a
Safe trace: a delegatecall to a known singleton whose calldata starts
with one of the historical setup() selectors. The singleton-to-version
map lives in seeds/safe_singletons.csv.

Covers every Safe version (0.1.0 through 1.4.1, including the Circles
1.1.1 fork and the L2 variants), including pre-v1.1.0 Safes that never
emitted SafeSetup.

Source: execution.traces. We use dedup_source(..., pre_filter=...) so
the time-range and selector filters land BEFORE the ROW_NUMBER window
function and ClickHouse can prune monthly partitions. This is the
largest scan in the family (8B traces, 5+ years) — every monthly batch
must fit under the CH Cloud memory budget.

Address normalization: execution.traces stores addresses + calldata as
lowercase hex WITHOUT a '0x' prefix. The seed values in safe_singletons
are stripped of the prefix when matching, and outputs (safe_address,
creation_singleton, tx_hash) are re-prefixed with '0x' so downstream
models see the canonical form.
int_execution_safes.name: int_execution_safes

int_execution_safes_current_owners.description:
Current owner set per Safe.

For each (safe_address, owner) pair, take the latest event by
(block_number, log_index). If the latest event is safe_setup or
added_owner, the owner is current; if removed_owner, the row is
dropped. Threshold is the latest safe_setup / changed_threshold per
Safe, denormalized onto every owner row.

`became_owner_at` is the timestamp of the most recent event that
added (or set up) this owner — for an owner who was removed and then
re-added, it is the re-add time, not the original setup time.

Cheap to fully rebuild every run; no incremental strategy needed.

int_execution_safes_owner_events.description:
Long-form ownership-event log for every Safe in contracts_safe_registry.

All ABI decoding is delegated to decode_logs(...) so no byte-offset
arithmetic lives in this repo. The wrapping model only:
  • unrolls SafeSetup.owners[] into one row per initial owner
  • normalizes AddedOwner / RemovedOwner / ChangedThreshold into the
    same (event_kind, owner, threshold) shape

IMPORTANT — incremental filtering:
  decode_logs handles its own var('start_month') / var('end_month')
  window AND its own `` max-timestamp incremental predicate.
  This model must NOT add another WHERE on block_timestamp — doing so
  would shadow decode_logs's filter and break incremental runs. The
  only thing the outer model mirrors from the batch pattern is the
  config-level incremental_strategy switch.

Decoded array shape:
  decode_logs emits arrays as toJSONString([...]) under the param name,
  so decoded_params['owners'] is a JSON array string like
  '["0xabc","0xdef"]'. ClickHouse JSONExtract* functions are 1-indexed.

SafeSetup unrolling uses a pre-filter subquery before the ARRAY JOIN
because ClickHouse evaluates ARRAY JOIN's range() expression before the
outer WHERE. Without the subquery, non-SafeSetup rows would reach the
ARRAY JOIN with NULL `owners` and `range(1, JSONLength(NULL)+1)` would
fail with `Illegal (null) value` — same fix pattern as
int_execution_gpay_roles_events.assign_role_rows.
int_execution_safes_owner_events.name: int_execution_safes_owner_events

int_execution_zodiac_modifier_module_eve.description:
Long-form append log of every EnabledModule / DisabledModule event
emitted BY a Zodiac Modifier proxy (Delay / Roles) — i.e. the sub-modules
enabled or disabled ON the Modifier itself.

The Zodiac Modifier emits EnabledModule(address module) NON-indexed
(module in data), unlike Gnosis Safe which emits it indexed. Decoded via
decode_logs against contracts_zodiac_modules_registry, which resolves the
mastercopy ABI (the non-indexed EnabledModule/DisabledModule rows were
added to the event_signatures seed for every vulnerable mastercopy).

This is NOT the same as int_execution_safes_module_events, which is
SafeProxy-scoped and therefore never sees Modifier-emitted events.
decode_logs handles its own incremental filter; do NOT add an outer
block_timestamp filter.

recent event is an enable. Full history lives in the events model.

int_live__dex_trades_raw.description:
Cached, rolling 48h window of unified DEX swaps across all supported protocols (Uniswap V3, Swapr V3, Balancer V2, Balancer V3) on Gnosis Chain. Normalizes amounts by token decimals, resolves symbols, and attaches USD prices per side via ASOF join against daily token prices. The final `amount_usd` uses the LEAST of the two priced sides when both are known (a conservative notional that rejects inflated long-tail prices), or the single available price when only one side is priced.
MATERIALIZATION: incremental ReplacingMergeTree, refreshed by a k8s CronJob running `dbt run --select +tag:live` every ~5 min. First run backfills the last 48h (source TTL). Each subsequent run delete+inserts the last `live_trades_overlap_minutes` (default 120 = 2h) to self-heal against cryo-live's out-of-order / bulk-attach inserts. 48h TTL on `block_timestamp` prevents unbounded growth and matches the source. Downstream api views read this table directly, so dashboard queries never trigger decode-log scans over `execution_live.logs`.

int_revenue_fees_weekly_per_user.description:
Weekly per-user fees per stream/symbol with trailing 52-calendar-week
rolling total (`annual_rolling_fees`). The weekly series is densified
per (stream, symbol, user) from the user's first observed week to the
last complete week in the write window, so
`ROWS BETWEEN 51 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW` represents a true
52-calendar-week trailing sum.

Week key convention: `toStartOfWeek(date, 1)` (Monday-start), matching
the weekly-mart convention used throughout the repo.

Memory strategy: the query is split per (stream_type, symbol) and
UNION ALL-ed so each aggregate / sort / window-function state is bounded
by a single stream-symbol's user population instead of the cross-product
of every symbol × every user at once. An optional `slice` var
(comma-separated `stream:SYMBOL` pairs, or a bare `SYMBOL`) selects
which slices to process per run; staged batches in schema.yml use it.

Incremental strategy:
  - Plain incremental: recompute the trailing `lookback_weeks` weeks;
    the upstream daily filter pulls `window_history_weeks` of prior
    source data so the rolling window has its full 52-week history for
    every rewritten week.
  - Batch refresh (`start_month` / `end_month`, driven by
    scripts/full_refresh/refresh.py): write only weeks whose
    `toStartOfMonth(week)` falls in [start_month, end_month]. Daily
    feed reaches `window_history_weeks` before `start_month` and
    extends 6 days past the last day of `end_month` so any ISO week
    that starts in `end_month` but finishes in the next calendar month
    is summed from all 7 of its daily rows; the next batch's
    start_month filter rejects that week's `toStartOfMonth`, preventing
    double-write.
int_revenue_fees_weekly_per_user.name: int_revenue_fees_weekly_per_user

int_revenue_ocsdai_user_balances_daily.description:
OpenCover OC-sDAI ERC-4626 vault look-through for the sDAI revenue stream.
Per (date, user) USD value of the sDAI underlying each OC-sDAI shareholder's
position: `balance_usd = oc_shares * share_price * sDAI_usd_price`, where
`oc_shares` is the per-holder OC-sDAI balance (int_execution_tokens_balances_native_daily),
`share_price` is sDAI-per-share (int_yields_ocsdai_share_price_daily), and
`sDAI_usd_price` comes from int_execution_token_prices_daily.

native sDAI and Aave aGnosDAI balances. The vault's own pooled sDAI is NOT
double-counted: it is held under the vault address, which the sdai model's
non_user_contracts anti-join drops (the vault is in tokens_whitelist). The
vault's self-held OC-sDAI shares (async escrow) are dropped by the same
downstream anti-join.

int_revenue_sdai_fees_daily.description:
Daily per-user sDAI revenue accruing to the DAO.
Methodology: `fees = balance_usd * sdai_daily_rate * dao_share_pct`,
where `sdai_daily_rate` comes from int_yields_sdai_rate_daily and
`dao_share_pct` (10%) is the share of the full rate assumed to accrue
to the DAO.

Tracks native sDAI balances (int_execution_tokens_balances_daily), sDAI
held in Aave V3 (aGnosDAI) from int_execution_lending_aave_user_balances_daily
— where `symbol = 'sDAI'` represents the aGnosDAI aToken holder; SparkLend is
excluded — and sDAI held via the OpenCover OC-sDAI ERC-4626 vault, looked
through to the underlying per holder in int_revenue_ocsdai_user_balances_daily.
The OC-sDAI vault's own pooled sDAI is excluded by the non_users anti-join
(the vault address is in tokens_whitelist) so it is not double-counted.

Per-protocol UBO supply claims for Aave V3 + SparkLend. Standardized shape: one row per (date, protocol, container_address, ubo_address) capturing the individual end-holder's withdrawable balance in the pool. Sourced from int_execution_lending_aave_user_balances_daily joined to lending_market_mapping for the container (aToken) address. Materialized daily so it can be re-used cheaply by any consumer.

Aave pool contracts are immutable so they always reference the original reserve address even after token migrations (e.g. EURe V1 0xcb44 → V2 0x420c on 2024-08-25). int_ubo_claims_balancer_v2_daily.description:
Per-protocol UBO supply claims for Balancer V2. Standardized shape: one row per (date, container_address, ubo_address, token_address) capturing each LP's net withdrawable token balance in the Balancer Vault.
Balancer V2 uses a single Vault contract (0xba12...2c8) that custodies all pool tokens. LPs interact with individual pool contracts but the token custody sits in the Vault, so container_address is the Vault for every row.
Balances are computed as a daily cumulative sum of PoolBalanceChanged event deltas from stg_pools__dex_liquidity_balancer_v2, keyed by (ubo_address, symbol) so that token migrations (e.g. EURe V1 → V2) collapse into a single series. token_address is the canonical contract per tokens_whitelist (symbol + date range) on each balance date.
Only whitelisted tokens (tokens_whitelist) are tracked. Positions with balance_raw <= 0 are excluded from output.

int_ubo_claims_swapr_v3_daily.description:
Per-user UBO supply claims for Swapr V3 (Algebra). Standardized shape: one row per (date, container_address, ubo_address, token_address) capturing each LP's net withdrawable token balance in a Swapr V3 pool.
Same two-track approach as Uniswap V3, but simpler because Swapr's IncreaseLiquidity event includes the pool address directly (no transaction_hash join needed). Each Swapr V3 pool is its own token custodian so container_address is the individual pool address.
Track A (direct LPs): the pool Mint/Burn owner field is the real LP. Track B (via NPM): the owner is the NonfungiblePositionManager (0x91fd...). The real LP is resolved from NPM Transfer events.

int_ubo_claims_uniswap_v3_daily.description:
Per-user UBO supply claims for Uniswap V3. Standardized shape: one row per (date, container_address, ubo_address, token_address) capturing each LP's net withdrawable token balance in a Uniswap V3 pool.
Unlike Balancer V2 (single Vault), each Uniswap V3 pool is its own token custodian so container_address is the individual pool address.
Two tracks of LP attribution are merged:
  - Track A (direct LPs, ~45%): the pool Mint/Burn event's owner field
    is the real LP — used directly from stg_pools__dex_liquidity_uniswap_v3.
  - Track B (via NPM, ~55%): the pool event's owner is the
    NonfungiblePositionManager (0xae8fbe...). The real LP is resolved by
    decoding NPM Transfer events (ERC-721 ownership per tokenId) and
    joining NPM IncreaseLiquidity/DecreaseLiquidity to pool events via
    transaction_hash.

Position transfers (LP A mints NFT → transfers to B → B burns) are handled by the Transfer event ownership chain. Balances are keyed by (ubo_address, symbol, container_address) through the cumsum so token migrations collapse into a single series.
int_ubo_claims_uniswap_v3_daily.name: int_ubo_claims_uniswap_v3_daily

int_yields_savings_xdai_rate_daily.description:
Canonical daily Savings xDAI vault rate for the Gnosis Savings xDAI vault
(0xaf204776c7245bF4147c2612BF6e5972Ee483701). Reconstructs end-of-day
share price from ERC4626 Deposit + Withdraw events on the vault, forward-
fills across event-less days, and derives a daily rate that is robust to
the vault's lump-sum yield distribution.

Why not a simple day-over-day ratio: on Gnosis, vault yield is NOT paid
continuously per block. The xDAI bridge on Mainnet accrues DSR interest
in the sDAI vault there, then periodically (every 1-2 days) calls
`relayInterest()` which pushes the accumulated xDAI/WXDAI through the
InterestReceiver, which in turn calls `payInterest()` to deposit the
batch into the Gnosis Savings xDAI vault, stepping up its `totalAssets()`
(and thus share_price) in a single tx. Between relays the share_price
observed at Deposit/Withdraw events is effectively flat; on a relay day
it jumps. A naive same-day ratio turns the ~7-day launch warmup
(single 1.3% jump on 2023-10-05) into a headline "11,000% APY" spike
even though the real yield over that period was ~60% annualized.

Fix: compute daily_rate as the GEOMETRIC SLOPE of share_price over a
7-day window:

    daily_rate = (share_price_today / share_price_7d_ago) ** (1/7) - 1

This naturally spreads a single lump-sum jump across the preceding week,
matching the protocol's accrual window. At steady state (no lumpiness)
it equals the true per-day rate. fct_yields_savings_xdai_apy_daily
annualizes this and layers 7DMA / 30DMA / 7DMM / 30DMM smoothing.

Regime columns (canonical_label, legacy_symbol, backing_asset,
yield_source) are joined from the savings_xdai_regimes seed so each date
carries the correct pre/post-2025-11-07 metadata (DAI/sDAI before the
bridge upgrade, USDS/sUSDS after, at the same vault address).
int_yields_savings_xdai_rate_daily.name: int_yields_savings_xdai_rate_daily

stg_mixpanel_ga__events.description:
Incremental staging table over raw Mixpanel events tracking Gnosis App
(app.gnosis.io) user interactions. Extracts all useful JSON properties
into typed columns with privacy transformations applied: distinct_id
and device_id are replaced with keyed pseudonyms via
macros/pseudonymize_address.sql (salted with env_var CEREBRO_PII_SALT,
so the hash is not reversible via rainbow tables against the public
on-chain address space), city-level geo is excluded, and full URLs are
reduced to path-only. Materialized as a table (not a view) so
downstream intermediate models read lightweight typed columns instead
of re-parsing the heavy JSON properties blob on every query.

Structure: a `raw` CTE extracts all JSON properties and computes
boolean flags. event_category is computed in the outer SELECT so it
can reference is_autocapture (a derived column) without a self-join.
To change classifications, edit macros/mixpanel_ga_event_category.sql.

Privacy notes: the keyed pseudonym macro is salted so hashes cannot
be reversed via rainbow tables against the public on-chain address
space. The same macro must be used on on-chain addresses for any
cross-domain join. The is_production flag identifies events from
app.gnosis.io (~89% of traffic; the remainder is deploy previews
and localhost).

New columns added for domain context:
  is_identified  — 1 if the user connected a wallet (distinct_id != '$device:*')
  is_production  — 1 if the event originated from app.gnosis.io (not preview/localhost)
  event_category — derived classification via macros/mixpanel_ga_event_category.sql
  event_amount, event_sku, event_seller, event_value, event_asset_id
                 — feature-specific custom properties for Circles/Marketplace/Swap events
stg_mixpanel_ga__events.name: stg_mixpanel_ga__events

stg_pools__balancer_v2_events.description:
Normalized signed token deltas for Balancer V2 pools, decoded from Vault events
(PoolBalanceChanged, PoolBalanceManaged, Swap, FlashLoan). PoolBalanceChanged rows
are unpacked from parallel JSON arrays of tokens and deltas; deltas are int256 but
sometimes serialized as their uint256 two's-complement representation, so negative
string values are parsed directly while unsigned values are reinterpreted via
reinterpretAsInt256(toUInt256OrNull(...)). PoolBalanceManaged rows sum cashDelta +
managedDelta with the same two's-complement decoding to give the net token delta.
Swap events emit two rows per swap: a positive delta_amount_raw for tokenIn
(amountIn) and a negative delta for tokenOut (-amountOut). Output is keyed by
pool_id, block_timestamp, transaction_hash, log_index, with token_address and a
signed delta_amount_raw (positive = tokens entering pool, negative = leaving),
filtered to non-null pool_id, token_address, and delta.

stg_pools__balancer_v3_events.description:
Unified Balancer V3 Vault event stream normalized into a single
row-shape: (pool_address | wrapped_token_address, block_timestamp,
transaction_hash, log_index, event_type, token_index | token_address,
delta_amount_raw, fee_amount_raw). Source:
contracts_BalancerV3_Vault_events. LiquidityAdded/Removed are exploded
by ARRAY JOIN over the amountsAdded/Removed arrays (one row per pool
token). Swap emits two rows (positive tokenIn, negative tokenOut).
Wrap/Unwrap/LiquidityAddedToBuffer events are emitted with
wrapped_token_address populated and pool_address NULL. Delta sign
convention: positive = tokens entering the pool/wrapper, negative =
leaving.

stg_pools__balancer_v3_pool_tokens.description: Ordered token list per Balancer V3 pool derived from Swap events. Balancer V3 stores tokens in ascending address order; ROW_NUMBER() over sorted unique token addresses reproduces the same 0-based index used in LiquidityAdded/LiquidityRemoved amountsRaw arrays. Tokens are the ERC4626 wrappers the pool actually holds (e.g. waGnoGNO, waGnoWETH) — resolve to underlying via stg_pools__balancer_v3_token_map for price lookups. Only pools with at least one Swap event appear; pools with deposited liquidity but zero swaps are excluded (negligible activity in practice).

stg_pools__v3_pool_registry.description:
Complete registry of Uniswap V3 and Swapr V3 (Algebra) pools on Gnosis Chain.
Combines factory creation events (PoolCreated for Uniswap V3, Pool for Swapr V3)
with pool Initialize events to produce a single source of truth for pool metadata.
Includes fee tier (static for UniV3, NULL for Swapr with dynamic fees), tick
spacing, initialization price/tick, and creation timestamp. Swapr V3 pools may
have their tick spacing updated via TickSpacing events; the latest value per pool
is used. Initialize events from pool contracts provide the initial price and tick.
Replaces the former int_execution_yields_v3_pool_meta view.
stg_pools__v3_pool_registry.name: stg_pools__v3_pool_registry
